name: tc-config-include
description: The default gate-fixture shape plus the package-root `vitest.config.ts` a consumer writes: `include` names `src/**/*.test.ts`, relative to the package root vitest resolves the config at. Scanned at `src/`, the gate must narrow the run to the colocated suite while leaving vitest rooted where the config is, so the include still resolves; the `tests/` tier fails loudly if ever collected. Every mutant is caught.
